title: Act: Close expired OPEN Rounds in Poll through the Closer
summary: Add the expiry case to Poll that calls Closer.Close and records ClosedNow
description: Extend Poller.Poll in poller.go with an OPEN case using the injected Clock.
acceptance_criteria: Expired OPEN Rounds are closed once; non-expired are not.
Closed IDs appear in ClosedNow and Closed.

out_of_scope: Error handling beyond collecting Close errors

technical_constraints: Use p.clock.Now().Before(r.EndsAt) for the expiry check
definition_of_done: poller.go builds and expired Rounds are closed

steps.lines: after the StatusClosed case of the switch written by act-detect
steps.action: Add case r.Status == StatusOpen && !p.clock.Now().Before(r.EndsAt): call p.closer.Close(ctx, p.worldID, r.ID); on nil error append r.ID to res.ClosedNow and res.Closed; on error append fmt.Errorf("poller: close %s: %w", r.ID, err) to a local errs slice. Return res and errors.Join(errs...) at the end. Convert the switch to a tagless switch to allow the condition.
steps.code:
case r.Status == StatusOpen && !p.clock.Now().Before(r.EndsAt):
	if err := p.closer.Close(ctx, p.worldID, r.ID); err != nil {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("poller: close %s: %w", r.ID, err))
		continue
	}
	res.ClosedNow = append(res.ClosedNow, r.ID)
	res.Closed = append(res.Closed, r.ID)
steps.expected: Expired OPEN Rounds are closed once and reported.
